review_candidates.title: Managed Services Engineer - End-User Computing / Microsoft 365
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Managed Services Engineer - End-User Computing / Microsoft 365 is responsible for resolving escalated Microsoft 365 and modern workplace incidents, changes, and service requests for ZainTECH's Managed Services customers. The role primarily supports the End-User Computing (EUC) pod while also providing Microsoft 365 tenant administration support to the Cloud & Compute (CC) pod. It also supports Exchange Online, Entra ID tenant administration, licensing, and SharePoint Online. Responsibilities
